metric_note: pair_accuracy -- Overall = subset-weighted pair-level accuracy (adjacent rows share one question over two images; a pair scores only when both rows hit), the MMVP official headline; Average is the item-level weighted mean, diagnostics only
weighting: score = sum(w_i * s_i) / sum(w_i); weights normalised so sum(w_i) == 1

pair_space.rule: rows 2p, 2p+1 = pair p (0-based row positions; anchor indices are pair indices)
